detail: Full summary: readers now disagree on one hand-written shape only — declaredRepoId (retrieval + migrate) takes repo_id first, repoIdFor (adapter runtime) takes repo_ids[0]; they coincide on every producer-written file because finalize writes identity.repo_id first and ensureStoreDescriptor only appends. test/retrieval/store-identity.test.ts 'prefers repo_id over repo_ids[0]' pins the divergent shape {repo_id:A, repo_ids:[B,A]} as desired; the store-identity.ts header claims agreement with repoIdFor only for the repo_id-absent case.
